Text that is printed to users (echo/printf messages, usage text) is frozen because log parsers depend on it: keep it byte-for-byte, even where it mentions get_cfg. Do not edit docs/ or tests/; the tests already use the new name. Make `make test` pass, then commit with a message starting with `refactor:`.
